shapeSummary: 20.32 x 12.7 mm PCB, 1.0 mm thick, lying in the XZ plane with its bottom at Y=0. It has one 2.18 mm through mounting hole near the -X end and eight simple boxes on top standing in for the IMU/magnetometer ICs, the regulator and passives. The pin row is on the +X edge.
warnings: The 3 mm catalog height is unverified. The PCB is assumed to be 1.0 mm thick and the components are modeled up to about 2.1 mm total height.
The component positions and sizes are approximate and estimated from the photo.
The five 0.1 in pin holes and the SA0 pad hole are visible, but their diameters are not stated, so they are omitted.
The mounting hole z position (+4.25) is estimated, and its side of the board is inferred from the photo orientation.
Silkscreen, solder pads, traces and vias are not modeled.
